# Rohit Mishra

Rohit Mishra is VP Product at Shopify. He works on commerce infrastructure across payments, tax, risk, money movement, and cross-border commerce.

Canonical site: https://www.rohitmishra.me/

## Profiles

- X: https://x.com/rohitmishra
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/arohitmishra
- Email: rohit@rohitmishra.me

## Product areas

- Shopify Payments — optimized payment acceptance across all channels
- Shop Pay — the best-converting wallet, used by 250M+ shoppers
- Shopify Markets — simplest way to sell internationally
- Shopify Tax — simplified end to end sales tax
